sky cinema premiere.title: Hitpig!
sky cinema premiere.desc: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realises that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

sky cinema premiere.title: Mother's Pride
sky cinema premiere.desc: About a failing pub, a divided community, and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

sky cinema premiere.title: Cold Storage
sky cinema premiere.desc: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

sky cinema premiere.title: How to Make a Killing
sky cinema premiere.desc: Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

sky cinema action.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
sky cinema action.desc: Beginning in ancient China, the ruthless Emperor Han will stop at nothing to gain control of the region. Many years on, in the 1940s, Han's tomb is discovered, and Rick O'Connell and his wife Evelyn get drawn into a plot to resurrect the emperor and restore him to power.

sky cinema action.title: Spider-Man
sky cinema action.desc: Adaptation of the adventures of the swinging comic-strip hero. A shy student becomes a crime fighter after a bite from a mutant spider, during a school outing, gives him extraordinary powers. As he comes to terms with his new-found abilities, he is also forced to contend with a maniac villain known as the Green Goblin.

sky cinema action.title: Fast & Furious 7
sky cinema action.desc: After defeating international terrorist Owen Shaw, Dominic Toretto, Brian O'Conner and the rest of the crew have separated to return to more normal lives. However, Deckard Shaw, Owen's older brother, is thirsty for revenge. A slick government agent offers to help Dom and company take care of Shaw in exchange for their help in rescuing a kidnapped computer hacker who has developed a powerful surveillance program.

sky cinema action.title: Fast & Furious 8
sky cinema action.desc: The globetrotting crew faces an unexpected challenge when a mysterious woman named Cipher forces Dom to betray them all. Now, they must unite to bring home the man who made them a family and stop her from unleashing chaos on a grand scale.

sky cinema action.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
sky cinema action.desc: Brixton Lorr is a cybernetically enhanced soldier who possesses superhuman strength, a brilliant mind and a lethal pathogen that could wipe out half of the world's population. It's now up to hulking lawman Luke Hobbs and lawless operative Deckard Shaw to put aside their past differences and work together to prevent the seemingly indestructible Lorr from destroying humanity.

sky cinema family.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Movie
sky cinema family.desc: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets a little more action than he bargained for, ending up in the Big City.

sky cinema family.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
sky cinema family.desc: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.

sky cinema family.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
sky cinema family.desc: The village is being overrun by rabbits and Wallace has a plan to alter their minds so that they will leave the vegetable allotments alone. However, his plan goes awry and the rabbit problem escalates when the villagers discover a monstrous `were-rabbit' destroying everything in its sights. Will Wallace and Gromit be able to solve the conundrum before the creature gets shot?

sky cinema family.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Movie
sky cinema family.desc: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets a little more action than he bargained for, ending up in the Big City.

sky cinema comedy.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
sky cinema comedy.desc: A grant-greedy principal puts two clueless teens in a bogus class for students with special needs.

sky cinema comedy.title: Police Academy
sky cinema comedy.desc: Misfits realise their dreams of becoming cops when a mayoral decree forces the police academy to open its doors to all.

sky cinema comedy.title: Coming 2 America
sky cinema comedy.desc: Needing a male heir to the throne, Prince Akeem returns to Queens, N.Y., to find his long-lost son and bring him back to Zamunda.

sky cinema comedy.title: Singin' in the Rain
sky cinema comedy.desc: When the transition is being made from silent films to `talkies', everyone has trouble adapting. Don and Lina have been cast repeatedly as a romantic couple, but when their latest film is remade into a musical, only Don has the voice for the new singing part. After a lot of practise with a diction coach, Lina still sounds terrible, and Kathy, a bright young aspiring actress, is hired to record over her voice.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bean: The Ultimate Disaster Movie
sky cinema comedy.desc: Mr Bean has somehow managed to get a job as a security guard. His latest assignment finds him travelling to America as an art expert, looking after the famous `Whistler's Mother' painting as it is transported from Britain to a posh new Los Angeles museum. The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Green Lantern
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A test pilot is granted a mystical green ring that bestows him with otherworldly powers, as well as membership into an intergalactic squadron tasked with keeping peace within the universe. Based on DC Comics characters.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Kirk, now an admiral, is called upon to take command of his old ship one last time in order to intercept a bizarre and deadly force heading towards Earth. One by one, he reassembles the original crew, and they set out to save the planet.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The past returns to haunt Admiral James Kirk when he and his crew become locked in a battle of wits with an old nemesis. His enemy Khan is looking for revenge and a potentially destructive device.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Kirk and the Enterprise crew defy Starfleet and return to the Genesis planet to reunite Spock's body and spirit.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Kirk and company travel back in time to 20th-century San Francisco, where two whales hold the key to Earth's future.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The Enterprise crew falls under the spell of Spock's half-brother, a renegade Vulcan on an obsessive quest to find God.

sky cinema thriller.title: Revolver
sky cinema thriller.desc: Jake Green is a hotshot gambler, long on audacity and short on common sense. Jake served seven years in jail for a crime he didn't commit after taking the rap for mean crime boss Dorothy Macha. Upon his release he takes on Macha in a private casino game, causes humiliation, and wins. While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down.

sky cinema thriller.title: No Country for Old Men
sky cinema thriller.desc: A man stumbles on the aftermath of a drug deal and takes off with the loot, but the bad guys are in hot pursuit.

sky cinema thriller.title: Black Bag
sky cinema thriller.desc: When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bank Job
sky cinema thriller.desc: London, 1971: Terry Leather's ex-girlfriend Martine turns up with a tempting proposition. A bank's alarm is scheduled to be turned off for a week, so Terry and his team tunnel through to the vault from a neighbouring property.

sky cinema thriller.title: Civil War
sky cinema thriller.desc: In a dystopian future America, a team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C., before rebel factions descend upon the White House.

sky cinema greats.title: The Big Heat
sky cinema greats.desc: An honest policeman is determined to bust police corruption and the stranglehold of the Mafia. At first he innocently begins investigating the Mafia-related killing of a fellow officer, but things turn nasty when his wife is killed in a car bomb blast meant for him, his child is threatened with kidnapping and he loses his job.

sky cinema greats.title: The Hunt for Red October
sky cinema greats.desc: Soviet and American forces give chase when the captain of a Soviet nuclear submarine sets a course for the Maine coast.

sky cinema greats.title: Dirty Harry
sky cinema greats.desc: A violent and uncompromising police officer hunts for a psychopath who holds the city of San Francisco to ransom. Although the officer's unorthodox methods do not endear him to his superiors, the mayor reluctantly agrees that Harry Callahan seems to be the right cop for the job.

sky cinema greats.title: Dog Day Afternoon
sky cinema greats.desc: A desperate and crazed man, with the help of an accomplice, takes a local Brooklyn bank hostage with plans to rob it in order to pay for his lover's sex-change operation.

sky cinema greats.title: Cool Hand Luke
sky cinema greats.desc: A gutsy prisoner earns the admiration of inmates and the wrath of guards by constant defiance and bids for freedom.

sky cinema drama.title: Eleanor the Great
sky cinema drama.desc: After the death of her oldest friend, 94-year-old Eleanor Morgenstein moves from Florida to New York City for a fresh start. Wandering into a support group for Holocaust survivors, she tells a tale that takes on a dangerous life of its own.

sky cinema drama.title: The History of Sound
sky cinema drama.desc: Two young men during World War I set out to record the lives, voices and music of their American countrymen.

sky cinema drama.title: Song Sung Blue
sky cinema drama.desc: Two down-on-their-luck performers form a Neil Diamond tribute band, proving it's never too late to find love and follow your dreams.

sky cinema drama.title: Footloose
sky cinema drama.desc: A rebellious teen incurs the wrath of a beloved clergyman by challenging the town's ban on loud music and dancing.

sky cinema drama.title: Jackie
sky cinema drama.desc: The days leading up to the tragedy of President John F. Kennedy's assassination and its immediate aftermath are chronicled as they were experienced by the First Lady, wife of the charismatic president and mother of two small children.

cartoon network.desc: A rival coffee shop moves into town. / Mordecai and Rigby have to unload a lot of boba.

boomerang.desc: Mr Bean celebrates his birthday at a restaurant with Teddy, unaware that he is to dine with a celebrity couple. Mr Bean goes to the cinema to watch some horror movies he gets spooked to the bone.

boomerang.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
boomerang.desc: Even for a giant seven foot bear, it's not easy getting rid of pesky Lemmings but it's all fun seeing them constantly try to outsmart each other with cheeky plans!

nicktoons.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

nicktoons.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

cartoonito.title: Masha and the Bear
cartoonito.desc: A little girl named Masha lives in the forest with her dog, goat and pig, often getting into funny situations. She befriends a paternal bear who tries to keep her away from disaster.

cartoonito.desc: Norman and Hannah set themselves up as The Why Files, investigators of the mysterious mysteries of Pontypandy. One of their first cases involves strange goings-on near the cliffs. cartoonito.title: Batwheels
cartoonito.desc: Batman receives help from a mysterious, yet somehow familiar, hero while pursuing the villain Croc through the tunnels of Gotham City.

cartoonito.title: Fireman Sam
cartoonito.desc: Protecting the citizens of the Welsh town of Pontypandy. Whenever the alarm sounds, brave Sam and his co-workers can be counted on to jump into a fire engine, hop onto a helicopter, and more, to help those in need.
